answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 11 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in velvet, queued in knoll, and ledge publishes the wait time. A farm of 256 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3574 identities would post 4383 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
